definition: A schedule used by self-employed individuals and sole proprietors to report income or loss from a business or professional activity, including gross income, cost of goods sold, business expenses, and net profit or loss.

includes.text: Reports business income and expenses for sole proprietors
Contains sections for income, cost of goods sold, and expenses
Reports final net profit or loss calculation

excludes.text: Reports rental real estate and royalty income not subject to self-employment tax
excludes.quote: Schedule E (Form 1040) to report rental real estate and royalty income

excludes.text: Used for farming income and loss
excludes.quote: Schedule F (Form 1040) to report profit or (loss) from farming

excludes.text: Used for employee business expenses, not self-employed business income

discriminators.text: Reports business income of a sole proprietor with self-employment tax implications; a sibling reports rental real estate and royalty income that is not subject to self-employment tax
discriminators.quote: Schedule E (Form 1040) to report rental real estate and royalty income or (loss) that is not subject to self-employment tax

discriminators.text: Reports profit or loss from any business or profession; a sibling is specifically for farming activities
discriminators.quote: Schedule F (Form 1040) to report profit or (loss) from farming

discriminators.text: Reports business income and deductions for self-employed individuals; a sibling is for employee business expenses only
